title: Jammer Jam
statementMd:
Swimming for exercise involves assigning swimmers to lanes suited to their fitness level.

We know the velocity of each swimmer in metres per hour. The swimmers start in any order but inevitably they will eventually become stuck behind the slowest swimmer in the lane and start matching their pace.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ecbb0da40478d2715ca320d8f69e0d2176f1b993.png)Illustration of Sample Input 3.

If we can assign swimmers to $l$ lanes, how can we ensure that the average speed of all of the swimmers in the pool (measured in metres per hour) is as high as possible? Output this average speed and an assignment of swimmers to lanes.

## Input

- One line containing the number of swimmers $n$ and the number of lanes $l$ ($1 \le l \le n \le 3\,000$).
- One line containing $n$ integers giving speeds $a_1 \ldots a_n$ of the swimmers, in metres per hour ($1 \le a \le 10^6$).

## Output

Output the maximum achievable average speed (mean metres per hour) on one line, followed by a possible assignment of swimmers to lanes to achieve this on the next line. The $i$th integer on this line is the lane number for the $i$th swimmer, $1 \le a \le l$.

The output must be accurate to an absolute or relative error of $10^{-6}$.
statementZhMd:
游泳健身时，需要根据游泳者的体能水平，为他们分配合适的泳道。

我们知道每位游泳者的速度，单位为米/小时。游泳者可以按任意顺序出发，但最终都会被所在泳道中最慢的游泳者挡住，并开始以与其相同的速度游泳。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ecbb0da40478d2715ca320d8f69e0d2176f1b993.png)样例输入 3 的示意图。

如果可以将游泳者分配到 $l$ 条泳道中，怎样才能使泳池内所有游泳者的平均速度（单位为米/小时）尽可能高？请输出这一平均速度，以及一种将游泳者分配到各泳道的方案。

## 输入格式

- 一行，包含游泳者人数 $n$ 和泳道数 $l$（$1 \le l \le n \le 3\,000$）。
- 一行，包含 $n$ 个整数，表示各位游泳者的速度 $a_1 \ldots a_n$，单位为米/小时（$1 \le a \le 10^6$）。

## 输出格式

第一行输出能够达到的最大平均速度（单位为米/小时），第二行输出一种达到该平均速度的泳道分配方案。第二行的第 $i$ 个整数表示第 $i$ 位游泳者所在的泳道编号，$1 \le a \le l$。

输出的绝对误差或相对误差必须不超过 $10^{-6}$。
